statement: (n r : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (z : Fin r → ℂ) (hz : Function.Injective z) (hroot : ∀ i, z i ^ n = 1) : (if r ≤ n + 1 then MvPolynomial.eval z (MvPolynomial.hsymm (Fin r) ℂ (n + 1 - r)) else 0) = 0
closed: ∀ (n r : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (z : Fin r → ℂ) (hz : Function.Injective z) (hroot : ∀ i, z i ^ n = 1), (if r ≤ n + 1 then MvPolynomial.eval z (MvPolynomial.hsymm (Fin r) ℂ (n + 1 - r)) else 0) = 0
original:
For a positive integer $r\geq 2$ , write

 $h_{n}(z_{1},\ldots,z_{r}):=\sum_{\begin{subarray}{c}\alpha\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}^{r}\\
\wt\alpha=n-r+1\end{subarray}}z_{1}^{\alpha_{1}}\cdots z_{r}^{\alpha_{r}}$ 

for the $n$ th complete homogeneous symmetric polynomial in the variables $z_{1},\ldots,z_{r}$ .
If $z_{1},\ldots,z_{r}$ are distinct $n$ th roots of unity, then $h_{n}(z_{1},\ldots,z_{r})=0$ .
type: ∀ (n r : ℕ), 1 < n → 2 ≤ r → ∀ (z : Fin r → ℂ), Function.Injective z → (∀ (i : Fin r), z i ^ n = 1) → (if r ≤ n + 1 then (MvPolynomial.eval z) (MvPolynomial.hsymm (Fin r) ℂ (n + 1 - r)) else 0) = 0
